title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-07-28
content:
Weekly sync notes - Solutions Engineering + Professional Services
Date: 2026-07-28
Facilitator / owner: Sofia Ramirez
Attendees: Sofia Ramirez, Ethan Waller, Priya Menon, Marcus Li, Janelle Park, Tom Becker (cs rep)

Objective: quick status across active customer integrations, surface engineering blockers, coordinate next steps and rollout windows.

Agenda:
- Roll call / quick wins
- Customer-by-customer status
- Blockers / escalations (SRE / infra / product)
- Action items and owners
- Calendar / upcoming maintenance that impacts integrations

Notes / highlights:
- Quick wins: automated smoke test for dedicated endpoints merged to staging (GH #764) helps reduce manual validation for Dedicated customers.
- Reminder: internal playbook updated with new KV-cache sizing guidance (Confluence page linked).

Customer A: FinTechCo (dedicated deployment)
Status: Late-stage validation, small-scale UAT ongoing
Recent activity:
- Dedicated cluster provisioned in us-west-2, config pinned to model v2.1-quant (requested by customer).
- Smoke tests passed 85% of cases; remaining failures tied to long-sequence truncation.
Blockers:
- Sequence truncation bug causing occasional mismatched tokens when prompt > 8k tokens. Root cause traced to attention-slice boundary handling in runtime.
- Need runtime patch and regression test before can flip traffic to canary.
Owner / next steps:
- Marcus Li to open SE-4123 with repro and test vectors (ETA 2026-07-29).
- Engineering (serving-runtime) to prioritize patch; PR target 2026-08-02.
- Priya to notify FinTechCo of ETA and schedule UAT window 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-05.
Risks:
- If fix extends beyond 2 weeks, customer may request temporary fallbacks to smaller context model (cost + quality tradeoff).

Customer B: MedData (private / VPC deployment)
Status: Data security review complete; on-prem package install scheduled
Recent activity:
- On-prem deploy package delivered to customer's infra team on 2026-07-20. Pre-install checklist done.
- KMS integration discussion active; customer requires HSM-backed key wrap (compliance).
Blockers:
- HSM vendor SDK incompatible with current KMS adaptor (runtime binding).
Owner / next steps:
- Ethan Waller to prototype HSM adaptor shim (workaround using our KMS path) and share patch by 2026-08-04.
- Janelle Park to coordinate vendor call (scheduled 2026-07-30) and capture vendor SDK timelines.
Risks / notes:
- Compliance timeline tight (audit planned for 2026-09). If vendor SDK timeline slips, plan B is using customer-managed key via supported cloud KMS (requires scoping).

Customer C: RetailAI (hosted API + routing policy)
Status: Integration live, experiencing occasional latency spikes during promos
Recent activity:
- Observability dashboards instrumented (per-route latency + token counts).
- Initial hypothesis: cache warmup + burst traffic causing queueing on shared pools.
Blockers:
- Need rate-limit tuning and provisional routing to dedicated pool during high traffic promos.
Owner / next steps:
- Priya Menon to work with product (routing) to create an ephemeral rule to route RetailAI to reserved burst capacity for promo windows; prototype by 2026-07-31.
- SRE (Tom) to add a short-term autoscale policy for shared pool to limit impact on other customers; ETA 2026-07-30.
Risks:
- Cost for promo routing higher; sales and customer success aware and will review billing impact.

Customer D: LegalDocs (embeddings + reranking)
Status: PoC progressing, quality regression observed on reranker after quantization change
Recent activity:
- Embedding batch jobs moved to deduped caching; throughput improved 2x.
- Reranker model quantized to int8 for cost savings last week; intrinsic quality drop noticed on site tests.
Blockers:
- Quality regression needs triage; may require re-ranking threshold tuning or revert quantization for reranker model.
Owner / next steps:
- Sofia to assemble eval suite for reranker (small labeled set) by 2026-07-29.
- Marcus to run comparison (float vs int8) and recommend config by 2026-07-31.

Cross-cutting / platform items:
- Serving-runtime: attention-slice fix (affecting Customer A) prioritized; expected PR early next week. Need compatibility regression tests across quantized and float paths.
- Observability: add per-customer token cost breakdown to the billing logs (product request). Feature request filed PROS-198.
- Private deployments: on-prem installer needs clearer preflight for HSM dependencies; create short checklist and include with package (Ethan + Janelle).

Action items (owners & due dates):
- SE-4123: Marcus Li to file bug + test vectors (2026-07-29)
- Runtime patch PR: serving-runtime eng to target 2026-08-02
- Notify FinTechCo and schedule UAT: Priya Menon (2026-07-30 customer comms, UAT 2026-08-03)
- Prototype HSM adaptor shim: Ethan Waller (2026-08-04)
- Vendor call and capture SDK timeline: Janelle Park (2026-07-30)
- Promo routing prototype for RetailAI: Priya Menon (2026-07-31)
- Short-term autoscale policy: SRE (Tom Becker) (2026-07-30)
- Reranker eval suite: Sofia Ramirez (2026-07-29)
- Quantization comparison results: Marcus Li (2026-07-31)
- Add billing token breakdown request: Product (filed PROS-198) - product owner follow-up 2026-08-06

Open questions / decisions to make:
- For Customer A, if runtime fix delayed beyond two weeks, do we: 1) provide fallback to smaller model, 2) expedite hotfix with potential risk, or 3) extend UAT window? Need exec decision from product owner.
- HSM support: do we accept a temporary shim workaround or pause until upstream SDK is supported? Security team input required.

Calendar / upcoming windows:
- Planned infra maintenance: 2026-08-01 02:00-04:00 UTC (may impact Dedicated provisioning). Priya to flag to customers with scheduled tasks (FinTechCo & RetailAI).
- Next sync: 2026-08-04 10:00 UTC

Notes to self / working bits:
- Draft email copy for FinTechCo UAT invite in Drive (links to smoke test results + repro).
- Add reranker labeled set to repo under se-evals/reranker/ (work-in-progress).

End of notes.
